items.text: Example project. Lines starting with a [Name] are dialogue for that speaker; plain paragraphs go to the Narrator. Comments like this one are notes for the production and are never spoken.
On a rock at the edge of the northern sea stood a lighthouse, and in the lighthouse lived a keeper named Tobias Wren.
items.speaker: narrator

items.text: Every evening for forty years, Tobias climbed the hundred and twelve steps to the lamp room. He trimmed the wick, polished the great glass lens, and watched the beam sweep out across the water.
items.speaker: narrator

items.text: Once a month, the supply boat came out from the harbour. This month it brought Clara, the harbourmaster's daughter, who was twelve and afraid of nothing.
items.speaker: narrator

items.text: Is it true you've never missed a single night?
items.speaker: clara

items.text: Yeah yeah i am also talking in the background while the two over there keep yapping about.
items.speaker: mack

items.text: Not one. Not in forty years.
items.speaker: tobias

items.text: Not even when you were ill?
items.speaker: clara

items.text: Especially not then. The sea doesn't care whether I have a cold.
items.speaker: tobias

items.text: Tobias is gruff but fond of her. Keep his lines slow and warm.
Clara laughed, and the gulls on the railing laughed with her.
items.speaker: narrator
